explication: OpenCore is a UEFI bootloader and Apple-oriented firmware support SDK. The principal workflow begins when UEFI firmware launches the OpenCore entry point, which loads configuration and storage data, presents boot choices, prepares a selected Apple or other OS image, applies compatibility and security handling, and starts the image. Supporting branches provide runtime-variable redirection, filesystem access, graphics/input/audio services, legacy platform support, and hardware protocols. The map emphasizes documented capabilities; several subsystem links remain omitted because their orchestrating callers were not sampled.
